policy.cutoffMeaning: Analyst-selected voltage cutoff, not an alarm threshold.
policy.denominator: Percentages use only finite selected-channel readings among the selected rows.
policy.rowMeaning: Source records include repeated aging readings and shared specimens, apparatus and calibration; they are not independent trials.
policy.zeroMeaning: A finite cached zero stays zero; it does not establish an enabled sensor, zero smoke, or nondetection.
policy.missingMeaning: Blank, error and non-numeric source values are retained and excluded from the finite denominator; no gap filling.
policy.channelMeaning: All selectable channels are volts. Obscuration volts are not percent obscuration; ion delta is not a detector alarm.
policy.filterMeaning: Flight and material selection does not validate instrument operation. Recorded use/quality fields remain attached to rows.
policy.sourceScope: Material Sort flight markers 1/2 only; ground records and other worksheets are not silently pooled.
policy.referenceMeaning: DBP is a reference material and is excluded by the default selection; 20 rows are available explicitly.

identityConflicts.statement: The 109-row SAME-R condition table and 109 flight-2 workbook records have different material/test identities. No automatic crosswalk, correction, deletion or row filling is applied.
